checks: Positive volume makes each compact convex fiber a convex body. For m equal to its full volume the density 1 is admissible in the parent’s trimmed barycenter set, giving the actual fiber centroid and raw own-fiber depth at least γ_d|K_u|_d for all containing closed halfspaces.

Every ambient cut containing the centroid restricts to a containing closed halfspace of the fiber plane or its entirety; other fibers add nonnegative mass. Thus the normalized maximum depth is at least γ_d|K_u|_d/M. Its strictly smaller bound than γ_d/k(U) gives the stated strict mass bound for every site. Summation and M>0 imply |U|>k(U).

The finite collection of distinct same-parity pairs is nonempty. For any globally shortest pair p,p+2v, v=mw with m≥2 would put p+2w in the lattice segment at parameter 1/m and hence in U. This is a distinct same-parity pair strictly shorter by norm homogeneity. Ties do not matter.
The integer midpoint p+v is in U by completeness, with parity distinct from the endpoints since v∉2L by primitivity. The coefficients 1/2 and 1/2 give exactly the stated Minkowski inclusion.
